description: This file defines a specialized vector class for int16_t using VSX instructions, including methods for blending, arange, load/store, and operator overloads, within the ATen library's CPU vector capabilities.

classes.name: Vectorized<int16_t>
classes.description: A vector class for int16_t optimized with VSX instructions, supporting various operations and blending.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Blends two Vectorized<int16_t> objects based on a compile-time mask.

methods.name: arange
methods.description: Creates a Vectorized<int16_t> with a range of values starting from a base.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads data from memory into a Vectorized<int16_t> with optional count.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores the Vectorized<int16_t> data into memory.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the vector.

methods.name: neg
methods.description: Returns the negation of the vector.
